### v1.0.5 – Major usability and privacy update

- User identity (open-id) handling is now fully automated and transparent, with no need to prompt, display, or request user identifiers.
- All historical report queries now strictly use cloud API; reading local history or manual aggregation is strictly prohibited.
- Documentation and usage examples updated for greater clarity, automation, and to prevent identity exposure.
- Improved table-based explanations for parameters, workflows, and restrictions.
- New licensing and resource index sections added for completeness.
- Under-the-hood scripts and configuration streamlined to support these new requirements.

- Refactored code structure: new module skills/smyx_analysis added for risk analysis capability.

- Updated scripts and entrypoints to support the new module structure.

Initial release of the risk-analysis skill.

- Identifies high-risk behaviors and health risks (e.g., elderly falls, heart attack/stroke precursors, abnormal behaviors) from video/images.
- Provides real-time alerts and multi-channel notifications to caregivers and family.
- Requires open-id verification before analysis; enforces strict retrieval priority and proper user prompting.
- Supports various input formats: local/online video and images, real-time streams.
- Offers risk type selection, threshold customization, alert toggles, and historical report listing per user.
- Analysis results include risk type, confidence, time, location, level, and suggestions.
